work.description: Complete V letter to Aloysia Maria Antonia Borbonica begins1508 with address1517–1518 and issuer1521, Italian body1528–1548 and Latin own date1550–1551. Own source citation1 Ex Archivio Brevium ad Principes1626 is separately retained; the adjacent allocution’s footnote2 at1629 is not absorbed. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
